subject: Sorry about the mix-up
text:
Hi,

I have been meaning to write since we spoke two days ago, and I finally had a moment to think through what happened. I am so sorry about the mix-up. I realize I confused the details in my earlier message and made the whole evening feel more complicated than it needed to be. That was not fair to you, especially when you were already trying to help me find the right materials and sort out the timing.

I wanted to follow up now rather than let the awkwardness sit. The version I have now is clearer, and I can double-check everything before sending it again. If you want, I can send a corrected note to the rest of the group tonight, or I can wait until you have looked it over. There is no rush, but I do not want you carrying the responsibility for an error I introduced.

You were patient with me when I should have been more careful. I appreciate that, and I am sorry I did not say it directly at the time. Our plans are still fine if you want them to be, and I would still enjoy meeting you for coffee when things are quieter.

Please tell me if anything still feels off in the details, because I would rather clear it up early than have it hang between us. I value our easy conversations more than I want to pretend this was nothing.
